verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API and a Java SDK that 'convert files in one line of code', but no CLI or shell command a script or CI step could invoke directly. A one-line SDK call and multi-step HTTP requests (submit to the jobs endpoint, wait, then download) are developer building blocks, not the documented one-line command the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented command converts a file in one line, usable from scripts and CI
